messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency for /v1/stream (SSE/WebSocket) breached 5s threshold across eu-west-1. Auto-paging oncall.
oncall_jess: I'm on it. Paging now. seeing spike in p95/p99. taking incident channel. :rotating_light:
sre_ash: saw proxy 502/504s and a lot of stalled chunk writes. Repro window ~5901234500-5901234550. digging into proxy logs.
eng-runtime-marco: any recent deploys to streaming proxy or runtime in last 30m? I see a canary rolled ~25m ago (feat/stream-chunk-coalesce)
sre_ash: yep that canary started at ~5901234400. traffic routed to canary at 10% then 50%.
eng-runtime-marco: ok hold. reverting canary to 10% and draining new instances.
support_lee: we have 3 customers in EU reporting partial responses and reconnects (ticket #6721, #6723, #6728). CS pinged them to say we're investigating.
cs_amanda: alerted top-10 customers via status update, asking for impact specifics.
ops-lead-noah: symptoms look like long tail chunk times + client backpressure. Proxy write buffers are filling, timeouts spike to 60s then 504.
sre_ash: quick log snippet from proxy:
```
2026-03-17T14:15:04Z proxy[pid=42] WARN chunk_write_timeout id=abcd1234 dur=6200ms backlog=128 client_window=2
2026-03-17T14:15:06Z proxy[pid=42] ERROR upstream_write 502 upstream=runtime-3 err=write ECONNRESET
```
sre_ash: also seeing sustained KV-cache misses and higher seq lengths on a subset of requests -> more tokens to stream per connection.
oncall_jess: mitigation plan? we need something fast that reduces client-side stalls and protects customers.
eng-runtime-marco: immediate mitigations we can try (2-5m): 1) reduce proxy keepalive idle timeout to avoid stale sockets; 2) enable proxy burst buffer for streaming; 3) temporarily lower canary traffic to 0% (done); 4) increase streaming proxy pool concurrency for eu-west-1.
sre_ash: doing 1 and 3 now. setting keepalive=30s -> apply patch to nginx/lb config.
ops-lead-noah: I'll scale up proxy pool + bump max_inflight_streams on proxy nodes.
sre_ash: applied keepalive change, rolling restart proxy pool (eu-west-1) - tracking.
eng-runtime-marco: also toggling feature flag `enable_chunk_coalesce=false` for canary to avoid coalescing path.
support_lee: CS: customers 6721/6723 confirm they saw stream resume after reconnects but felt increased latency. No data loss reported yet.
oncall_jess: metrics: p95 dropped from 1.8s->1.2s after fixes, p99 still at ~4.7s but trending down. keeping page until p99 < 3s for 10m.
sre_ash: root cause hypothesis: new chunk coalescing path increases head-of-line blocking under certain client-window distributions; combined with proxy buffer limits caused backpressure and connection resets.
eng-runtime-marco: next step for safety: add a streaming-specific circuit breaker to route overloaded streams to a fallback short-chunk variant. I'll open an RFC/quick-change.
ops-lead-noah: customer-facing mitigation: temporarily enable per-tenant throttles for heavy streaming sessions. ops on it.
oncall_jess: assigning postmortem owner: @sre_ash. please capture timelines, canary rollout, proxy behavior, and recommended fixes (code + infra + runbook updates).
cs_amanda: I'll follow up with impacted customers with timeline and ETA for root cause.
oncall_jess: handing off to next oncall @oncall_next_kim for overnight watch. Summary: p99 breach caused by chunk-coalesce + proxy buffer/backpressure. Immediate mitigations applied: revert canary, keepalive reduced, proxy pool scaled, feature flag off. p99 trending down but still above target. If it creeps up again, escalate to infra oncall.
oncall_next_kim: acked, I'll monitor charts and on-call pager. leave notes for morning rotation. :white_check_mark:
